sense.text:
“I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.” King David understood that God has been his God since the time he was in his mother’s womb, before he was ever brought forth. God was already working while he was in the womb, before conception, before mother and father ever came together. God had all of it planned.

Everything has been meticulously detailed by the Lord. There is no happenstance and no osmosis: the Lord has every detail already inscribed and prescribed from the very beginning. The same Lord ordained that Ezekiel would see, in the time of Babylon, the exceeding great army of the last days, the valley of dry bones come together: Israel united in Christ.

Stay in the spirit. Staying in the spirit does not always mean staying quiet; sometimes it requires you to be vocal, and being in the spirit gives the discernment to know which is right at that time, when to speak, when not to speak, and how to move. We have this very large book of instructions called the Bible, and it makes no sense for the application to be lackluster. We have to apply it.

precepts.why:
“To fear the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb.” To fear the Lord is the beginning stage of a wise understanding: to understand that there are judgments and repercussions for wrongdoing and sin. That gives the discernment to say, let me not do this, because this is the punishment if I do it. Fearing the Lord is the beginning of the whole of wisdom, of understanding how things operate and why they are in perfect order: why the Lord created judgments, because he created laws that were not to be broken.

And that wisdom ushered in through the fear of the Lord was “created with the faithful in the womb.” That is super heavy. The Lord ordained from the womb that the child in that womb is faithful enough to have the wisdom of the Lord upon delivery. Before the child is born, the Lord has already ordained some things.

So none of us are here by happenstance. Some think they stumbled on a YouTube video, or walked by the camp that day on the way somewhere else. You did not stumble on anything. The Lord had already determined it.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers”. Whether it came by YouTube, or by walking past the camp while the brothers were teaching on the way to a tailgate, a FIFA soccer game, or the Knicks championship game, wherever you thought you were going, the Lord says your eyes shall see your teachers. When the Lord has determined for you to see your teachers, there is nothing you can do to avoid it. Where you thought you were planning to go is where the Lord had already ordained for you to go.

You thought you were going to the beach with the family, to Blitz the Beach or Orange Crush, with floaties around your arms, and you never thought in a million years you would see the prophets of God on the beach. But his saints that were ordained from the womb were out there, taken by Satan and given into their own lust, and they must see their teachers. Their teachers will be in places they never expected them to be. Thousands of young brothers and sisters flocked down to Savannah, Georgia and took the long way around to get past the camps outside the beach. God said no, you are going to see your teachers. You said I am not going that way because I am dressed in my drawers. That is what a bikini is: your drawers.

“And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.” As you thought to go around where the prophets would be, you heard a word behind you, and that word instructed you that this is the way. No matter which direction you planned to go, God made sure you heard it.

“For I was a witty child, and had a good spirit.” King Solomon was witty, quick, sharp and full of understanding, and had a good spirit from the time of childhood. Sirach showed that wisdom is with the faithful in the womb; here Solomon goes deeper, showing that spirit carried over past birth into his toddler years. It is not speaking of how soon a child walks or talks. A child may take longer than his siblings, may need the little hard-bottomed shoes to learn to walk, the kind well-off families dipped in bronze and kept as a memento, and still have that good spirit from the womb.

“Yea rather, being good, I came into a body undefiled.” In the space of two verses Solomon speaks of himself and then goes prophetic, future tense, as Christ: the body undefiled is Christ.

“Nevertheless, when I perceived that I could not otherwise obtain her, except God gave her me”. Solomon could not obtain wisdom by any other means. Some in the scriptures tried to buy the spirit of God, requested it, lied and cheated trying to obtain it. There is nothing you can do except the Lord himself give it to you. You have to pray, fast and study, and the Lord gives it liberally to those who ask.

But here is the kicker: you have to be pre-ordained. Not ordained as a minister, but that spirit that started from the womb had to be your lot from the beginning. Those who are pre-ordained, predestined, foreknown, the elect of God, will obtain the wisdom, retain the wisdom and apply the wisdom. Those who are not will have trouble obtaining it, retaining it or applying it.

“And that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was”. God is dealing not only with those who need and desire wisdom but with wisdom herself: whomever I give you to, I am giving them a gift. Wisdom understands she is not for everybody, and God has to give you that wisdom, that spirit. Solomon then “prayed unto the Lord, and besought him”.

sense.text:
“But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.” There is a spirit in man and a spirit in woman, and that spirit begins from the time of the womb. The inspiration of the Almighty gives the understanding.

The spirit is placed on us from the womb; we just do not know it yet. When we were born we thought we would be a mama’s boy, or play in Pee-Wee League or Pop Warner. We all have our way of thinking our life is supposed to turn out, but that is not necessarily what God ordained from the time we were in our mother’s womb. Pray earnestly that we all stay in the spirit no matter what the circumstance holds.

precepts.why: “And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she maketh all things new”. Wisdom, that spirit, the breath of the power of God, has the ability to make all things new, and that includes us.

“Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature”. Wisdom makes all things new, and whoever is in Christ is a new creature. The two go together because the power and the wisdom of God make all things new: being in Christ is being made new by the wisdom of God.

“And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding”. That rod out of the stem of Jesse is Christ, and the spirit of wisdom and understanding rests upon him. So when you are in Christ you are a new creature, because wisdom makes all things new.

“The spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord; And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord”. Quick understanding: remember Solomon said he was a witty child. That shows the spirit that is in a man from the womb. That is why, when Mary went to visit Elizabeth, John leaped within her: there is a spirit in the womb.

That is the spirit of Christ: “he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears”.

“But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.” Christ is the wisdom of God. So any man in Christ is a new creature, because the power and the wisdom of God make all things new.

sense.text:
“Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation, Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.” God is the God of all spirits, and he sets a man over the congregation.

On the broad scale this is the nation of Israel. Bring it down to the micro level and it is the various offices we are in. There has to be order and structure both nationwide and locally: there are national offices, international offices and local offices as well.
“Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him”. Joshua had the spirit, the Holy Spirit, upon him, just as Caleb had another spirit with him.

“And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.” Brothers have been given the same charge as leaders, as heads of offices, as parts and helps in various offices, and it was done in the sight of the whole office, the whole congregation, the whole nation. You have been given the parameters of your office in the sight of everybody.

“And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him”. As the head of an office or the deacon over a region gives you a charge and duties, some of their honour is placed on you. You are in Atlanta now, but as you are raised up in rank your job may take you somewhere else, or the bishops may call for brothers in other countries, and you may be the brother sent to be in the spirit and help that congregation grow.

“That all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.” The honour is placed so that all the children of Israel understand: this is the head of that office, the head of that school, the lead in this capacity, the helps in that one; go to this person for that thing. Everybody understands the order God is setting up.

So the congregation, on the large scale and the small, depends on that leader, that head of office, that steward, to be in the spirit and to bear that honour honourably. A treasurer who steals holds his office dishonourably. You are placed in these capacities, first to be in the spirit, and second to bear the honour that was placed on you.

precepts.why:
“Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice; Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it”. All of the nation from twenty years old and upward would not make it into the land.

“But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him”. Caleb was not moving in the same spirit as everyone else. In Acts one drew away four hundred men; how do you know not to go along with whatever that heresy is? There has to be another spirit within you. And that spirit is already there, ordained of God from the very beginning.

Joshua had the spirit, and Isaiah 11 encapsulates all the tenets of the Holy Spirit, the spirit that rested on Christ. “And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord”. What the Holy Spirit consists of is the spirit of wisdom and understanding; it is also called the spirit of the Lord.

“But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth”. Reproving with equity means not being partial. Having the spirit of the Lord, you are not going to be in partiality; you will obtain the wisdom, retain it and apply it.

“And he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips”. Christ is the power and the wisdom of God, and here is the power he will have as well. This is the list of all that is encapsulated in the spirit of God: power, knowledge and understanding, not judging by the sight of the eyes but with righteousness. That is the spirit Joshua and Caleb had.

“And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes”. Spies were sent out to spy out the land and bring back a report. Joshua and Caleb reported that the land could be taken; the others brought an evil report, deceptive, trying to diminish the power of the Lord, and the Lord judged them for it. Joshua and Caleb rent their clothes: they were furious and sorrowful at the false report.

“If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us”. “Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us”. Through the power of the Lord the land could be taken; the only thing that would keep them out was rebelling against the Lord. It is the same with us: we have an inheritance the Lord ordained for us, and the only stipulation is, do not rebel against the Lord. They are bread for us: food for us.

That is how Joshua and Caleb showed they had a different kind of spirit: they did not go along with the general populace and its false report. How do you know not to go along with what the populace is saying when it is contrary to the Lord? The spirit of God must be upon you.

Staying in the spirit does not always mean remaining quiet. That bashful stuff has to stop: sometimes you have to speak up. But when you speak up, those who do not have the spirit of the Lord will always have a certain kind of reaction: “their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not. But all the congregation bade stone them with stones.” Two men with the spirit of God, who understood God’s mission for the nation, encouraged them to go take the land the Lord ordained, and the congregation said let us stone them, instead of doing what God said. “And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.”

sense.text:
“Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love”. The class began in the womb; this is before the womb. When you are in the womb, it is the vessel already pre-ordained, predestined, foreknown, coming through as he ordained. A mother is already carrying the prophet or the princess that was already in Christ before the world was made. Some say there is no way he chose me, Cleopus Jenkins Jr., before the world was made. Then you do not believe what God said.

In Ephesus there were Gentiles and Greeks living by Hellenized means, worshipping other gods. Paul is telling them that before they ever became Hellenized they were already chosen to hear the gospel of Christ and follow after him. That was ordained before the Greek captivity, before the Roman captivity, before Persia and Babylon.

precepts.why:
“Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia”. Peter is not only dealing with Ephesus but with the other places where the Israelites are scattered, and he calls them “Elect”: chosen, handpicked.

Peter’s epistles come after his growth, after learning so much and making so many mistakes, after Christ told him Satan desired to have him and sift him as wheat, after the cock crowed thrice and Christ looked at him and he wept sore. That is with all of us as well: brothers, young men, sisters, young sisters, Satan desires to have you. All of that became part of Peter’s understanding, so he could write with much more clarity than when he walked with Christ.

“Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father”. Foreknowledge is knowing before: before the world was made the election was already had. All the apostles speak the same thing. Paul said it in Ephesians 1, Peter says the same, and Paul expounds further: before the foundation of the world.

“through sanctification of the Spirit”. Sanctification means to be set apart, made holy for God’s special use. You are set apart through the spirit. That is how you went from all manner of filth and wickedness to being here; how you went from thinking you were going to a tailgate, a football, baseball or basketball game, a Black market festival, an African festival or a Juneteenth festival, to standing in front of the camp listening for over an hour, and the brothers showing you Black history before the transatlantic slave trade, in Rome and in Russia. You were elected, and the election is according to God knowing you before that event.

The Lord brings it all together in one instance. Stumbling on a video of a Bishop teaching history in his house, using the Bible and history books at the same time, archaeological finds and paintings of men dark like me, a history that resembled me, and hearing Christ’s voice in it, hooked. Watching the brothers in purple bringing fire on the streets of New York, then seeing that same Bishop walking with the men in purple, and it all made sense: I have to be there. These brothers are like no one I have ever seen in my entire life, and I want to be a part of that. Through that sanctification of the spirit we heard the word and changed our ways. We cannot remain the same or keep walking around the same wilderness. Young men, you have to be the real world changers.

“unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.” You are set apart in order to be obedient. You are no longer going to call yourself African-American or whatever garbage we call ourselves out there. You are the twelve tribes of Israel, because that is what you agreed to before the world was made, and breaking the bread confirms the agreement you already made.

The prophet says the same as the apostles. “And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me. For then every one obeyed”. Before the world was made there was a council, and no one spoke against what was ordained. Christ, talking with all these spirits, laid out how he would create everything in perfect synchronization: the trees giving off oxygen, the bees carrying pollen, the operations of the earth moving in perfect harmony, until the white man started pulling things out of the earth and messing it all up. Your damn chemicals are killing the bees, and now you want us to feel sorry for the bees. You the damn devil. Woe unto them that destroy the earth.

There were others there in that council. Christ said these spirits here are the twelve tribes of Israel, those spirits are the Jebusites, and so on, and no one disagreed: before the creator you are not going to say, no, I do not want to be the Edomites. It is like a director who writes the movie and hands each actor the script: one reads the script and agrees to play the Black Panther, another agrees to play Killmonger, portrayed as the bad guy though Killmonger is actually the good guy. Michael B. Jordan agreed to that role, Chadwick Boseman agreed to his, everybody agreed to their role, and then the movie was made and we all watched it and cheered, Wakanda forever. In the same way the Lord sat in his council and everyone was given their roles and their tasks. He already knew who would be in which womb.

“but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed”.

“As for the ungodly, wrath came upon them without mercy unto the end: for he knew before what they would do”. The chapter before goes into the destruction of Egypt and all the plagues. God did not show mercy in his wrath because he already knew what they were going to do: the same foreknowledge by which the elect were chosen.

“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” The Lord knows how we are all going to move because it is already ordained. While Jeremiah ran around playing as a little kid, the Lord already had him as a mighty prophet in the earth.

It is the same for the young men here. Learning this truth when you did is ordained of the Lord. At ten, eleven, twelve years old, back in the day, you might not have withstood the trials that came to many brothers and sisters when YouTube was not what it is now and there was not a class online for every topic. The Lord calls you when he needs to call you. It is ordained for you to be here in 2026 at your young age, when your parents can send you a class for the spirit you are dealing with, so that you can abide. Many fell out since those days.

sense.text: “Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience”. The class is stay in the spirit, so the question is which spirit you are staying in. First Peter showed sanctification of the spirit unto obedience. If you are obedient, you are moving in the Lord’s spirit. If you are disobedient, whose spirit are you moving in? Being disobedient is a spirit as well, and that spirit of disobedience is at work in some of us.

“Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh”. If your conversation now is in the lust of your flesh, who are you obedient to? That includes porn; that includes inappropriate conversation with an ex. Now we can determine if we are in the spirit of the Lord or the spirit of Satan. It is that simple. That is why things are kept secret: you know they are wrong and not of the Lord.

“we all”. Some did not want to answer, but the Bible says we all, some more than others, some more often than others. “fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.” When children are disobedient to their parents, who are they following? Satan. Speaking reproachfully, rebellion, which is as the sin of witchcraft, stubbornness: we have all given into it. We have to see what spirit we are moving in.

precepts.why:
“Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”. The devil counts you as a disgruntled employee. You were once fervent for your former employer, in all manner of lust, evil and concupiscence, lying and slandering. We have all worked for Satan at some point.

Being honest about that is how you get to the application of the wisdom. Satan loves for you to be in denial, because those in denial make the best at covering things up, the best liars, the best slanderers, willing to defame anyone to save themselves. The Lord loves confession, confessing your faults. Satan says keep it all a secret: they don’t know you like I know you. You’ve been employed by me for thirty-something years, and after one year you are going to go with these new people? And he can say that very confidently, because it is true.

“Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.” Satan will tempt you to keep it quiet, keep it under wraps, nobody is going to know. If you do that, you are not resisting the devil; you are doing what he told you to do. Confessing is part of resisting.

“Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil. And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred. And when the tempter came to him”. Another name for the devil is the tempter. All he has to do is present a certain temptation for you to take in, lock in, and go right back to your former boss. And you ain’t got to say nothing, they’ll never know: that is one of Satan’s greatest devices, and it is untrue, because your spirit says more than your mouth ever will. You cannot mask it. Trying to hide that spirit that is weighing you down is like Shaq hiding behind a tree. It is obvious.

“If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread. But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.” Look how Christ dealt with it: with what is written. We have to remind ourselves of these things when the temptations come. This is not only said to others: in teaching it, we are cutting ourselves as well.

Satan came after the forty days of fasting, when Christ was in a weakened state in the flesh. It is the same among brothers and sisters: in a weak state spiritually, or physically from surgery or pain, Satan says nobody called to check on you, I would never do you like that, because now you are not in the body. After an argument with your spouse you go for a drive, and Satan is in the passenger seat: you ain’t got to go back home; she don’t know you like I know you. That is why thoughts you have not had in years start to form in your mind. You cannot remember what you had for lunch yesterday, but the tempter remembers everything and whispers the memory into your ear, and you think it is your own thought. A sister cools off after an argument and Satan reminds her of Cleopus Jenkins back in ’73 with his Studebaker and his eight-track. Satan knows everything about you and Cleopus, from before you met your husband, because you were his employee.

“Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth”. Christ is the firstborn of every creature, the first created, and by him all things in heaven were created: the angels, the host of heaven, Satan included. So the creation was trying to tempt the creator. Satan knew that was the creator, but he came after the forty days, in a weakened state in the flesh, thinking, I can surely tempt him; this is what he created me to do. If Satan will tempt his creator, how much more will he tempt us?

We think temptation was exclusive to Christ, because our minds revert very easily to being Black folks and not Israelites. “Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone; And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith”. The Thessalonians had seen tribulation and trials, and Timotheus was sent to comfort them.

“That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.” The objective is that none of you is moved by the afflictions; we are appointed to them. “For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.” The apostles warned them, and whether they believed it or not, they knew it to be true when it came to pass.

“lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.” Christ was tempted in a weakened state after his fast; during afflictions we are mentally, physically and spiritually in a weakened state, and the tempter is going to tempt us. If, because of the afflictions, they said we are not going to follow Christ any more, we are going back to animal sacrifice, that was the tempter tempting them, and the apostles’ labour would be in vain.

That is why it matters to stay in the spirit of the Lord. A man who was here around 2016 and 2017, who was never around long enough to endure and be built up (he never even had an official purple shirt), is now online as an apologist calling himself an ex Black Hebrew Israelite, doing videos with Vocab Malone and Mark Riser, going to the devil himself. When tribulation came he did not want to address the elephant in the room, so he left and rebranded himself. He is not the first, and he is not the only one.

sense.text:
“All scripture is given by inspiration of God”. Anyone who has dealt with us in a council setting knows we go to the scriptures. So your anger and disdain are not with us; they are with God. That deep sinking feeling in your diaphragm, wanting to get upset, is Satan stirring you up to be disobedient to what God has said, using your emotions to unravel you.

“and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness”. In confession there is correction, and in counsel there are instructions and wisdom, and this is where many brothers and sisters get hung up in this truth. Brother, I don’t think this is a good move for you, because this can be the result; don’t go down this path. Some brothers get upset, get in their feelings, and still do what they want to do. My hands are clear: I gave you the instruction in righteousness.

precepts.why:
“All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them. They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge. Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.” “The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.” The Lord says through Solomon that he hates evil, pride and arrogancy.

“Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom”. In council, when the word of God is coming out, it is the Lord ordaining the discussion. When an inquiry is made, brother, you were seen doing this, that and the third, speak on it, the Lord is in the midst of it. But Satan is right there in the midst of the council as well, telling you this is not of the Lord.

Warning someone is sound wisdom. A brother was warned that, with the thing he battles with, a certain job was not the right one for him, or at least to work in a department by himself. He took it anyway, and months later he had to quit the job he was told not to take. When counsel is contrary to what you want to hear, you do not hear it. “I am understanding; I have strength.”

sense.text: “For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.” There are some among us whose lot is to receive another spirit. The early part of the class was the spirit of the Lord; this is the spirit of Satan, the deceiver, the tempter. It is another spirit because it is contrary to what the apostles and the prophets taught.

“Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.” We know it is the last time when we see those that go contrary to Christ.

The man who left did so in 2018, when the Bishop brought out the understanding of the new moon being the full moon. He said this is heresy and left. It was not, I will stay in the commandments and keep the dark moon as the new moon, still rehearsing the righteous acts. He went back to Caesar. Some are ordained for that. He wanted to make merchandise of the people; when he wanted to promote his album he went around the brothers on the radio show by the back door, and when he was counselled, be mindful, you’re moving very worldly, he took it as if he had been cursed out. Some brothers and sisters hate the warning. Eight years later he is online teaching how false we are, and he is still a failure for the gospel’s sake.

“They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.” This is the antichrist, and there are many. They separated themselves because they were not part of the elect. The elect are chosen from the womb, and further back, before the foundation of the world.

“These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.” The topic of the chapter is the antichrist, and here John shows how the seduction comes about.

“But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you”. The seduction is done by teaching. The antichrist is not floating in the air going booger booger; they are going to be teaching you something. That is what all these apologetics are: the spirit of antichrist. This does not mean the Bishops and Deacons cannot teach us. It is speaking of the men who fell away and revealed they are not of us, who now all of a sudden want to teach you: Christ didn’t exist, Christ didn’t die on the cross, didn’t rise from the dead, or now Christ is a white man, with not one scripture to back it up. The seduction will always be there, because Satan’s spirit worketh in the children of disobedience: learning the commandments and then saying we can eat whatever we want, worship on Sunday, we don’t have to keep the Sabbath holy.

“but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.” The anointing is the spirit of Christ the class began with, the wisdom we have been asking for, and it teaches you all things.

So who should never gain your ear or teach you anything? Those who were among us and went out. The gripes, unresolved issues, hatred and jealousy within us are what Satan uses as a reason for you to go back to Caesar: he spoke rough to me, he didn’t say anything to me. Some, no matter what you do, you cannot make happy.

precepts.why:
“These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.” There are those ordained to be the sensual brother and the sensual sister, without the spirit of the Lord. How can we prove it? The Lord requires us to assemble on the holy Sabbath day. When the spirit rises up in you to stay home, to play Sabbath sick, to forsake the assembling one with another, whose spirit are you moving in? The Lord is about unity, not separation.

When that spirit rises up you have to recognize it, Satan is trying to get me, and force yourself past that point. You do not wake up on the right side of the bed every day, but you do not call off from work every day either: you still go shuffle the white man’s papers and stand by the water cooler acting interested. The hope is that once we are among each other, someone who has the spirit of the Lord is so infectious it jumps on me and I get in the spirit of the Lord.

“And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!” Somebody had to be Judas. When you read Zechariah, Judas was chosen a long time ago, not just when he walked with Christ. Woe is destruction unto him that betrays.

“Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.” Whoever delivered him, whoever betrayed him, has the greater sin. It was not just Judas; it was the chief priests, the scribes and the Pharisees too.

“The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.” That is cold-blooded: it would have been better for the betrayer never to have been born. Can a betrayer repent? Yes. Will the betrayer still have to answer to God? Yes.

“But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.” The Lord’s spirit is in his brothers and sisters. So those who betray us, the body of Christ, are betraying Christ, and it would have been better for them never to have been born.

“And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.” That is the nation of Israel, the elect of Israel. The Lord has kept a cluster of grapes from destruction: the one third.

“Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain”. That is the two thirds, as Zechariah calls them. They were born in vain; it would have been better that they had not been born. This is the group the betrayers come from, and the slanderers and haters of our people. Nothing profitable comes out of that vain group: just confusion, a casting up of dust, a loud noise from a multitude, never anything productive. Show me the Christian men standing up manfully against oppression; show me the exceeding great army of Christianity. It does not exist.

“and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.” There is great labour behind getting brothers and sisters in the right spirit. It looks like the Lord has forgotten us, scattered to the four corners of the earth, but think how quickly we came from where we were to where we are now spiritually: the Lord has done a mighty work.

sense.text: “Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.” The concision means the precise cut: those who are supposed to sit in Moses’ seat, the doctors of the law, those who are supposed to know something. Beware of them, because they are dogs.

“For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.” We are the worshippers of Christ, but others try to diminish the fullness of Christ, make a mockery of it and lie on it, and then strain at a gnat. In that sit-down they talked about the virgin birth and the Trinity, while our people are being killed: a brother goes to a music festival and ends up hung. You don’t see any of that, but you want to talk about the Trinity. You stupid. Have no confidence in the flesh whatsoever.

precepts.why:
“And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces”. Paul said beware of dogs; Christ tells you who to beware of: the scribes and Pharisees. All we can do is warn you. That was around the same time we began putting Mark Riser on the screen and shaming him, the devil he is, and the man who left did not beware: as soon as he left he went right to Mark Riser. Whether brothers and sisters take heed is up to them.

“And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.” Greater damnation, because they were born in vain, and it had been best they had not been born.

Pretence is an attempt to make something that is not the case appear true, a claim, especially a false one. Their prayers are made to seem true, but they are false, done to be seen of men and to make a show. The apologist conferences are held to appear righteous, as if defending the gospel. They are just working for their father, the devil.

sense.text:
“Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?” “This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.” In First John the seduction came through teaching; here Paul says some will hinder you from following Christ through persuasion. It is all saying the same thing. When someone draws you away from Christ, to another spirit or another gospel, that persuasion does not come from Christ.

Make sure you are in the spirit, because Satan plays the long game. He plants a seed now and does not revisit it until a year later. You have a small issue with another member of the body; a year later another issue arises, and Satan tells you to put the two together into one claim against that person. If that person apologized a year ago, should it even come back up? Who is bringing it back up? Satan.
“A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.” A little leaven in the congregation can leaven the whole congregation, fill it with sin.

“I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded”. Paul’s encouragement: I have no doubt you will remain in the spirit, even though they are trying to persuade you. “but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.” Those troubling them were the scribes, Pharisees, Sadducees and chief priests whom Christ said to beware of, coming in as in Acts 15 and drawing men and women back to animal sacrifice. Going back to animal sacrifice means rejecting Jesus the Christ.

“And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased. I would they were even cut off which trouble you.” Paul says nothing different from what Christ said, that it were better they had never been born, and what Ezra said, that they were born in vain. They will have destruction because they are trying to hinder the gospel, trying to hinder the spirit of Christ filling the earth.

“For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another. For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.” Paul is quoting Leviticus 19. But loving thy neighbour goes into not holding grudges and into rebuking your neighbour: those two verses are wrapped up in it. This is where Christians omit the totality of what it is talking about. The New Testament is a summarized version of the Old Testament, not expounded as much as some passages in the Old, so for better understanding you have to go to the Old Testament.

“But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.” Beware of dogs: dogs bite and devour one another. If we follow the same methods as the Pharisees, being underhanded, deceitful, slanderers, murderous, grudgeful, we are no different from those dogs.

“This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” This is the conclusion: walk in the spirit, stay in the spirit. If you stay in the spirit you do not have to worry about those lust-filled thoughts, doing anything according to your flesh, whatever you desire to do, which is always going to be contrary to what God has said. Stay in the spirit, Israel.

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.” Everybody understands that part: don’t hate your brother, don’t hate your neighbour. Yeah, I don’t hate anybody. But keep reading.

“Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people”. Bringing up an issue from a year ago means you still have a grudge. Would God bring up that grudge? That is Satan. It is always going to be opposite to what God requires. You hang on to the grudge, and then you are sitting in counsel saying things that are not accurate. That is why, in counsel, every point is checked bit by bit, is that accurate, so that Satan is revealed in the midst of the conversation and it is seen who has the devil on them.

That commandment is what Paul quotes in Galatians 5:14: loving thy neighbour goes into not holding grudges and into rebuking your neighbour.

“So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow. Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him. For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.” Paul wants to know whether the church of Corinth is obedient in all things.

“To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also”. That is what a leader does: if the church agrees to forgive the brother, Paul, the chief apostle over it, forgives him as well. He does not need to know every intricacy. Y’all forgive him? Then let’s move on.

“Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.” The topic is forgiveness, and a grudge is the opposite of forgiveness. So unforgiveness, bearing a grudge, is a device of Satan. Bear the grudge, something else happens and the grudge gets greater, and now you have full-blown hatred, the very first part of the commandment in Leviticus 19. Satan will always want you to do the opposite of what God requires. God requires us to believe on Christ as it is written; Satan says that don’t matter. We cannot be ignorant of Satan’s devices.
